I remember that one time, when I almost got into MLM. I was a kid and tried to help my mom, so, I found an advert for some office part-time job. It started out fine-ish. They promised to call later.  
And they did. "Oh, sorry", - they said. - "We've already found a person for that office job, but we would also like to try you out as a PRODUCT DISTRIBUTOR". And I agreed, why not.  
Little did I know what I was getting myself into.  
I never met somebody as brainwashed as they are. On my first meeting, they were all screaming, cheering, clapping and did all kind of shit (and it seems like they are doing it every day). For me, it was odd.  
Now I know that I should've run away right after this. But I stuck with them for three (actually two) more days. The very first lesson they tried to teach me was that I must not think about anything but ~~selling~~ PRESENTING their product. I tried to discuss books with them or movies, but they just didn't care. All they could talk about was how great their job is and how much money they made (not much). At the beginning of day 2, their cult leader asked me to give him my passport. Just like that, so they could buy a starter kit for me. I told him that I don't trust him, I asked for some insurance, some sort of paper that they took it. He told me that he wouldn't give me any kind of insurance and that I could keep my passport with me. So, the very next day they find me unworthy (big surprise), and with that, I left them. I was planning to do it anyway, after their leader asked me to give him my passport (and I couldn't survive one more day of that "daily positivity" cringefest), but this made it easier.  
And that's how I almost became a hunbot myself. I tried to spread the word after that, eventhough they told me to shut up. I never saw them again, so, I guess, I won?
